subject.title: Create Claw agent and root install record

question: Should OpenClaw sponsor the Claws core lifecycle now and authorize this consented agent/root-provenance slice to land after its read-only base?
rationale: The patch is technically coherent and proven, but it creates durable CLI, manifest, persisted-state, ownership, and future upgrade contracts across a multi-PR stack; only maintainer intent can decide whether core should adopt that product surface.

options.title: Pause pending RFC acceptance
options.body: Keep this protected pull request open until maintainers accept or narrow the RFC and the read-only base is ready to land.

options.title: Sponsor ordered landing
options.body: Approve the current lifecycle direction, land https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101328 first, then review and merge this slice with explicit ownership of the persistent contract.

options.title: Decline the core lifecycle
options.body: Close the implementation stack if Claws should not become a core OpenClaw feature.

recommendation.title: Pause pending RFC acceptance
recommendation.body: Keep this protected pull request open until maintainers accept or narrow the RFC and the read-only base is ready to land.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest available history-backed owner for canonical shared state and the core lifecycle decision this slice requires.
